# Support and Project Help

For build or contribution questions, start with `docs/community/START_HERE.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md`.

Use the structured issue forms for reproducible bugs, scientific/model proposals and performance findings. Architecture-changing proposals should follow `docs/community/RFC_PROCESS.md`.

Do not publish exploit details for an unpatched vulnerability in a normal issue. Follow `SECURITY.md`; private vulnerability reporting is a blocking public-launch requirement and must be configured before broad promotion.
